plurals.item: Kusele ukuthepha okungu-%d ukuze uvule izinketho zonjiniyela
Kusele ukuthepha okungu-%d ukuze uvule izinketho zonjiniyela

resources.string: Isexwayiso: lezi zinketho zivumela ukubhala okungakaqinisekiswa kumodeli yakho yesilinganisi somfutho wegazi. Ukubhala okunjalo kungonakalisa unomphela izilungiselelo zesilinganisi. Zenzelwe kuphela abantu abaqinisekisa imodeli ngesilinganisi abakulungele ukusilahlekelwa.
Vumela ukuvumelanisa iwashi kuzilinganisi lapho kungakahlolwa khona

Ukusetha iwashi akukaqinisekiswa kulawa mamodeli ezilinganisi. Ukukwenza noma kunjalo kungonakalisa unomphela izilungiselelo zesilinganisi noma kusenze singasebenziseki.

Lesi sishintshi asithumeli lutho ngokwaso. Uma kamuva usetha iwashi lesilinganisi esinjalo, umbiko wedivayisi uqopha ukuthi kuzanywe ukubhala okungakahlolwa.

Unesibopho sanoma yimuphi umonakalo esilinganisini sakho.
Izinketho zonjiniyela zifihliwe; zonke izishintshi zonjiniyela zivaliwe
Vumela ukubhalisa iphrofayela kuzilinganisi lapho kungakahlolwa khona

Ukubhalisa iphrofayela kubhala umsebenzisi okhethiwe newashi ezilungiselelweni zesilinganisi. Akukaqinisekiswa kulawa mamodeli ezilinganisi. Ukukwenza noma kunjalo kungonakalisa unomphela izilungiselelo zesilinganisi noma kusenze singasebenziseki.

Lesi sishintshi asithumeli lutho ngokwaso. Ukubhalisa kusenzeka kuphela uma ukhetha u-“Bhangqa” bese uqinisekisa, futhi umbiko wedivayisi uqopha ukuthi kuzanywe ukubhala okungakahlolwa.

Unesibopho sanoma yimuphi umonakalo esilinganisini sakho.
Lezi zishintshi zivula izindlela zokuxhumana ezikhona ku-app kodwa ezingakaze zihlolwe esilinganisini sangempela. Zingavele zihluleke.
Sebenzisa ukuxhumana okubethelwe uma ubhangqa i-X7

Le ndlela ikhona ku-app kodwa ayikaze ihlolwe esilinganisini sangempela, futhi ingavele ihluleke. Ukubhangqa ngale ndlela kungase kuthathele leli foni indawo yokubhangqa okukhona kwesilinganisi. Ukubhala okwehlulekile kungonakalisa unomphela izilungiselelo zesilinganisi noma kusenze singasebenziseki.

Lesi sishintshi asithumeli lutho ngokwaso. Umbiko wedivayisi ubala ukuthi yiziphi izishintshi zonjiniyela ebezivuliwe.
